title: Instant Pot® Vegetarian White "Chicken" Chili
description: Each bowl of this vegetarian white "chicken" chili made in the Instant Pot® is loaded with pinto beans, corn, cauliflower, and Quorn™--a tasty meatless substitute for chicken.
ingredients: 2 jalapeno peppers, seeded and finely chopped
1 (12 ounce) package artificial chicken pieces (such as Quorn™)
2 (16 ounce) cans pinto beans, rinsed and drained
2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro, or to taste

steps.text: Turn on a multi-functional pressure cooker (such as Instant Pot®), select Saute function, and add olive oil. Add onion, jalapeno peppers, bell pepper, and garlic to hot oil; saute until onions begins to soften, about 3 minutes. Add artificial chicken pieces and saute for another 3 minutes.
Add vegetable broth, pinto beans, frozen cauliflower, frozen corn, oregano, cumin, pepper, and salt. Close and lock the lid. Select Soup function and set timer for 15 minutes.

Release pressure using the natural-release method according to manufacturer's instructions, for 5 minutes. Release remaining pressure carefully using the quick-release method according to manufacturer's instructions, about 5 minutes. Unlock and remove the lid.
Stir in sour cream. Ladle into bowls and top with fresh cilantro.
